Params: {3: 'The "door" slowly closes, and the <phonetic=Kurumi Tokisaki\'s>  girl\'s  </phonetic> silhouette vanishes behind the dark currents.'}
{3: 'Her warmth still lingers on your fingertips. Her calm eyes still remain in your vision. Yet, the darkness beyond the "door" has undoubtedly devoured everything already.'}
{3: 'You pull your hand back, dazed, fingers frozen mid-air.'}
{3: "The searing emotion in your chest isn't disbelief. It's rage. How could she have orchestrated everything so calmly, deceived you so thoroughly, and then walked alone toward the end?"}
{1: '1', 2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "There's no need to glare at me like that.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "If you knew the whole truth, you'd agree with what I'm doing too.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The "door" vanishes. She takes a step forward, her heels clicking against the ground in a crisp, unhurried rhythm.'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'I really should be thanking you, you know. You cleared out all those troublesome Nightmares for me.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'This world can only exist if a delicate balance is maintained between the Deep Dream and the Dream Realm.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'But lately, there have been far too many Nightmares. So many that they could tear through the "door" and prey on my little lambs at will... That\'s why I used you to eliminate them and restore my power.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She tilts her head slightly. She smiles, yet her eyes are as hollow and deep as a dark well.'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'But then you refused to follow my script. You instilled doubt into my little lambs, inciting them to question this perfect paradise...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'Should the Dream Realm collapse, the millions of innocent lives living here would die along with it. Do you understand how dangerous your actions are?', 4: '1'}
{2: "But you're just deceiving them. You're hiding the existence of the Deep Dream from them.", 3: '35'}
{2: "You've never told them that this Dream Realm of yours can only sustain itself by having the Nightmares feed on the living.", 3: '36'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "Heh, and what makes you so sure they wouldn't choose to stay, even after learning the truth?", 4: '1'}
{3: "She sneers as her fingertips trace along her other arm, as though caressing a child that isn't there."}

{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "What you've seen today is just the tip of the iceberg. You have no idea what kind of despair those people experienced, what drove them to willingly enter this paradise.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Her voice turns cold in an instant, that hollow smile vanishing without a trace.'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "Very well then. Let me give you a taste of the truth you've sought so desperately.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'As soon as the words leave her lips, the world before you suddenly inverts.'}
{3: 'A cold, clammy sensation creeps up your senses as a torrent of overlapping cries and anguish is forced into your mind.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Emaciated Woman', 3: "(P-Please, I'm begging you, stop stepping on me...! Please stop!)", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Emaciated Woman', 3: "(Why won't any of you stop for just a second and look below you!)", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Destitute Man', 3: "Heh... worked myself to the bone for years, scraping together all those savings... and for what? One day, and poof. It's all gone.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Destitute Man', 3: "I knew it... Like hell there's a way to get rich overnight! It's all a scam! Lies they wove to trick poor folks like us!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Heartbroken Woman', 3: "I gave him everything... so why would he do this to me? What does she have that I don't...?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Heartbroken Woman', 3: "After everything that's happened, how come they can get off scot-free, just like that? I wish he'd just die along with that woman!", 4: '1'}
{2: '(Use all your strength to anchor your mind)', 3: '103'}
{1: '1', 3: 'You grit your teeth and struggle to stay conscious amid the onslaught of visions.'}
{3: "You must not give in. The moment your will falters, you'll end up like all the others—completely assimilated and dissolved by the Nightmare."}
{3: 'You force yourself free from the torrent, desperately clinging to your sanity as you shout at the flickering white figure on the other side of the void—'}
{2: "Is that it? You think showing me their despair would automatically make what you're doing right?", 3: '107'}
{2: 'What about you? Even after feeding on their lives like this, is that cold, condescending indifference all you can offer?', 3: '108'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "...Such spirit. You're the first little lamb to make it this far.", 4: '1'}
{3: "The ceaseless wailing fades, replaced by a single cold voice echoing through the empty depths of the spider's nest."}
{1: '1', 2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "I've changed my mind. You're different from the other souls. I'll keep you here as the core of this dream.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'Come. Let me show you where this dream began.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The moment she finishes speaking, the putrid nest vanishes, swept away by a world of pure white.'}
{3: 'The woven tapestry of horrors fades like the rain, revealing the outline of some ruins ahead.'}
{3: "What unfolds is a scene all too familiar to you. It's the world you came from."}
{3: 'As the white fog clears, a figure emerges from the scorched earth. A girl is there, lying inside some kind of mechanical device.'}

{3: "Her hair is short and disheveled, and she has a gaunt face. Her features are strikingly similar to Nozomi, the Dream Master from before. However, her clothes are tattered, and she's gasping in agony inside the pod."}
{1: '1', 2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "As someone born after the Golden Age, I'd venture to guess you've never seen one of these before, yes?", 4: '18'}
{3: 'The Oneiros is somehow behind you now, even though you never heard her approach. Her hand, cold and devoid of all warmth, rests gently on your right shoulder.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'This is where I was born. Inside what you call a Dream Machine. It was made with one purpose—to grant the wishes of anyone who lies within it, unconditionally.', 4: '15'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "Human dreams are truly remarkable. Sometimes, even I can't help but admire their imagination.", 4: '15'}

{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'The wealthy crave power. The powerful crave dominion over the world. But those who stand at the very peak? They would question whether the love they receive is even real.', 4: '15'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'I crafted dream after dream for them, but they were never satisfied. They only demanded more and more from me.', 4: '15'}
{3: 'Her cold hand suddenly tightens around your shoulder, her fingers almost carving a few marks there, before she slowly relaxes her grip.'}

{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "But thanks to them, I accumulated vast amounts of data. When the Church's apostles came and enlightened me, I finally understood all those countless desires for what they truly were.", 4: '15'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'And I finally understood why all humans are lonely.', 4: '15'}
{3: 'The woman smiles softly and slightly tilts her head. Beneath her delicate bionic features, crude mechanical components peek through.'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "I thought to myself then: since I've granted so many dreams for humanity, surely granting one for myself would be more than fair?", 4: '15'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'But then, what would I use as a vessel for this dream...?', 4: '15'}
{1: '1', 3: "She crouches down beside the Dream Machine, tracing her fingers along the glass tenderly, as if she's caressing the face of the girl within."}

{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'This girl, born after the Punishing Virus Outbreak, who never knew a single day of peace before her companions abandoned her in the ruins to be torn apart by the Corrupted.', 4: '15'}

{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "She must have mistaken me for a medical pod that could heal her wounds. That's why, in her final moments, she crawled desperately into my chamber and connected to my mind.", 4: '15'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'But through that twist of fate, I glimpsed the most beautiful dream.', 4: '15'}
{3: 'She lowers her gaze, her eyes seemingly shimmering with compassion.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'In her dream, there were no vile, festering desires or endless greed. She only had one simple wish.', 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'To live happily alongside the very companions who abandoned her.', 4: '18'}

{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "What a pure, untainted wish! She's never once experienced bliss for herself, yet in her final moments, she still prayed with all her heart for the happiness of others.", 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'And so I made my decision. I would build an eternal dream for her—the most beautiful yet ordinary world imaginable.', 4: '1'}
{3: "The heartbeat monitor inside the Dream Machine beeps steadily, each pulse a reminder that the girl's life is slipping away."}

{3: "The searing pain in your head intensifies. Under The Oneiros's influence, your senses gradually sync with the girl inside the pod, forcing you to endure the same agony she felt in her final moments."}
{2: 'So that\'s why you created another "Nozomi" in the dream?', 3: '245'}
{1: '1', 2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'Unfortunately, not even the most beautiful dream can bring back the dead.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'That said... I was fortunate enough to seize that singular, irreplaceable miracle.', 4: '1'}
{3: "The stabbing pain suddenly vanishes. Perhaps unable to watch the girl's final moments any longer, The Oneiros raises her hand once more, scattering the vision into wisps of smoke."}
{1: '1', 2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "Spacequakes... That's what you humans call them, if I recall correctly. But you never truly understood what they are.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'But in that <phonetic=Kurumi Tokisaki\'s>  little lamb\'s  </phonetic> nightmare, I found my answer. It was an outbreak of what\'s called "Spiritual Power"—a method of information corruption remarkably similar to the Punishing Virus.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "Through <phonetic=Kurumi Tokisaki>    her    </phonetic> unconscious wish, I seized that miracle and used it to forcibly link everyone's dreams together.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'And so, I finally created a sanctuary where Nozomi could slumber forever.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Her voice drops, and what little warmth it held vanishes entirely.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "You know, I actually specially invited those so-called comrades who left her to die in the ruins. But when I appeared before them wearing Nozomi's face...", 4: '18'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'Not one of them showed remorse. Not one of them shed a single tear.', 4: '18'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'Every single one of them put on the same act, feigning joy as they pretended nothing had ever happened. "We knew it! We knew you couldn\'t have died back then!"', 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'How absurd. Even though they made that decision together and resolved to sacrifice her so the rest could live, they dared pretend otherwise.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'Of course not. I simply made them experience the same despair Nozomi felt back then.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The woman with the mechanical body walks slowly to the center of the nest and bends down, lifting a single thread.'}
{3: 'The countless Nightmares down there in the abyss shriek, clawing at the threads and desperately trying to climb their way up.'}

{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "Nightmares are converted from human despair. In other words, if they had felt even a shred of guilt, if they had the resolve to keep going even if it's just to apologize to <phonetic=Nozomi>her</phonetic>... they wouldn't have fallen into this hell.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'Yet not one of them lasted more than five minutes.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'So their redemption will never come.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Snap. The woman severs the thread. The cries below grow more anguished.'}
{3: "But there's not a trace of mercy on her expression. Seeing that, you finally understand something."}
{2: "Your actions have nothing to do with upholding justice. You're just reveling in your own twisted sense of revenge.", 3: '310'}
{2: 'Nozomi was someone who prayed for the companions who abandoned her, even at the very end of her life.', 3: '311'}

{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "How laughable. You would still defend them even after seeing the full truth? I guess you are human, too, after all. Our stances ensure we'll never understand one another.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "But I'm not bothered by it. I'll tolerate all your selfish desires.", 4: '1'}
{3: "The Oneiros slowly rises from beside the abyss. The spider's nest, once calm, stirs once more as countless threads tremble in silence."}
{3: 'She gently clasps her hands together. At the same time, a black tide rises from the depths, coalescing into a massive claw that blots out the sky and lunges toward you.'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "That's why I will place you in the deepest part of this beautiful dream. You will become the most solid foundation of this realm...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Wails far more violent than before surge like a raging tide through your every limb, nearly too much for you to withstand.'}
{3: 'But within the torrential flood of information, beyond the shrieks of countless souls—'}
{3: 'Even more fragmented and scattered visions come crashing into your mind.'}
{2: 'Hippocrates', 3: '【kuroname】 is regaining consciousness! Nurse, prepare for electrical brain stimulation and begin multisensory stimulation!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Liv', 3: "Please, hang in there a little longer! We know you're fighting...!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: "Mind Beacon connection almost established! We'll be with you soon!", 4: '1'}
{3: "You take a step forward, as if to answer the calls of your comrades fighting in the other world. Your boot's heel strikes the illusory ground beneath."}
{2: '我确实无法理解你这么做的根由，但就如你明明知晓一切，却仍只会得出错误的结论。', 3: '383'}
{2: "You can't understand why we humans are so weak, why we would run and spite each other... Even so, we might reconcile one day.", 3: '384'}
{2: "And more than that, you refuse to believe that we'd still have the courage to face reality after leaving your dream.", 3: '385'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "Pretty words won't help you now, you know.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'The fact remains that your own kind committed those acts of betrayal, that you would devour one another. Be it within reality or dreams.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: "What I offer to <phonetic=Nozomi>humanity</phonetic> is a truly perfect paradise. If you want to convince me that what I've seen isn't your true nature—", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The black tide yet roils, and then, it transforms into countless Nightmares shrieking in twisted forms, as if lamenting their sorrows. They surge toward you with piercing wails.'}
{3: 'A roar escapes from your clenched teeth as your flesh collides with the black tide in a thunderous crash.'}
{3: 'You continue forward, arms crossed. The stance is not one of battle, no—this is the "proof" you\'ll present.'}
{3: 'Proof that humanity truly possesses the will to stand against despair with nothing but flesh and blood.'}
{2: "I<Human>'ve been planning to do that since the start!", 3: '428'}

{3: "At that very moment, as darkness and crimson clash violently, the pocket watch at your chest, which has been silent for so long, suddenly emanates a gentle thread of warm, golden light. It's almost as if it's responding to your declaration."}
{3: 'A voice, gentle yet impossibly clear, almost incongruous, rings out leisurely within the wailing darkness.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Though I can't say I mind it, human.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'A swirl of crimson fabric descends gracefully from the darkness, unfurling like a blood-red rose in full bloom.'}

{3: 'Pristine and radiant as if newly reborn, she touches down with one foot while bending the other knee elegantly. She lifts her head slightly, offering a graceful curtsy to the Dream Master on the other side.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Hmm... judging by the marker, this should be the right "time."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'I hope I made it in time for the grand feast, "Nozomi."', 4: '1'}
{3: "A crack finally appears in the facade that the woman has maintained all this time. For the first time, she's genuinely shocked."}
{2: 'The Oneiros', 3: 'You... but you should have fallen into the deepest depths of the Dream Realm along with those Nightmares...', 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Oh, you wouldn\'t be referring to that abandoned amusement park you call a "nightmare," would you...? If that\'s the case, I must apologize for the misunderstanding.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'The truth is, I entered that place of my own accord. I did so to reclaim my power.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'A playful smile crosses her face as she touches her chin with her fingertips. Her mismatched gold and red eyes gleam under the dim light, her expression sly.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "You didn't actually think a nightmare of that caliber could drive a true <color=#34aff8ff>Nightmare<Nightmare></color>, such as myself, to despair, did you?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Tokisaki!', 3: '482', 4: 'I need your help to stop the Dream Master!', 5: '482'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "There's no need to be so formal, Commandant.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Golden light swirls as the girl's signature weapons materialize in her hands once more—a pair of flintlock pistols, one long and one short. She grips them firmly, pointing them forward."}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: '"Let\'s turn this world upside down together, Miss Kurumi."', 4: '1'}
